title: triorchis
intro: Triorchis, commonly known as the Three-angled or Three-ribbed Triorchis, is a genus of flowering plants in the family Gentianaceae. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and is used to treat various ailments such as fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Triorchis include its ability to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections, making it a popular natural remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Triorchis include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
